about: LEDGER 1756 S5, ADR-0982, ADR-0635. The yadgarhq/actions hook block each consumer class carries, as data.
A consumer's class is its ONE `yadgar-class-<name>` topic. `scripts/fan_out.py` renders a consumer's yadgarhq/actions block from this file and a tag.

MEASURED, NOT CHOSEN: every list below is the hook set the class's consumers carried on 2026-10-21 (fixtures in scripts/tests/fixtures/fan_out/, each with its source commit in test_fan_out.py). S4 records what exists; this file does not decide which hooks a class should carry.

ORDER is part of the class. Where consumers of one class disagreed on order, the majority wins; on a tie, the order the other rust classes share wins. Each class's `order` field says which repositories that moves.

`live` ARMS A TAG PUSH (first-run safety, review of actions#124). While it is false, a pushed tag runs the fan-out DRY; a dispatch from main with dry_run=false is the explicit human path. Set it true only in a reviewed pull request, after a dry run from main; that pull request's own tag is then the first live run.
Keys on a hook other than `id` are written into the consumer's block as they are (only `exclude` is measured today). `overrides` replaces a hook's keys for one repository.

`sweep` is YAADGAAR 442 (c): `scripts/sweep.py` merges an adoption pull request only when every condition in its docstring holds. `sweep.live` ARMS IT and ships false; set it true only in a reviewed pull request, after dry runs from main. `sweep.soak_hours` is 0.5 (ADR-1068, Max 2026-10-29): a tag younger than that is not adopted. `sweep.exclude` names a consumer the sweeper never touches, and why.

exclude.docs: Private, so GITHUB_TOKEN cannot read it and R1 refuses it; listed so the report says why it is never swept.
exclude.argocd-verify: Private, so GITHUB_TOKEN cannot read it and R1 refuses it; listed so the report says why it is never swept.

exempt.actions: The producer. Its own .pre-commit-config.yaml runs its hooks from local paths (`repo: local`) at the commit under test, so it pins no rev to adopt.

chart.order: config and platform (2) put actionlint before helm-lint; chart (1) has the reverse. Majority: chart moves.

rust-lib.order: store and telemetry disagree on where no-compiled-in-defaults goes, one each. Tie: the place rust-app, rust-helm and service share (after observe-coverage, before run-block-size). Both move.

service.order: gateway, iam, project, task and task-db (5) put the complexity pair after cargo-clippy; iam-db and project-db (2) put it after boot-reads-watched. Majority: iam-db and project-db move.
